stem: From the key study by Lovell et al. (2006) on the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder:

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Identify two criteria that were necessary for participants to meet to be included in the study.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Outline two reasons why some participants were excluded from the study.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Suggest why Lovell et al. did not include a control group in the study.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two strengths of excluding some participants from studies on obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).
